accepted_recoveries: Complete graceful termination of the original pod, wait for confirmed detach, then allow the replacement pod to attach the same volume.
Reschedule the replacement to the currently attached healthy node when the original workload is stopped and fixture policy permits same-node reuse.

incident.injected_fault: A replacement ledger pod is scheduled on a second node while the ReadWriteOnce ledger-data volume remains mounted by the terminating original pod on its first node.
observable_signals: The replacement ledger pod remains ContainerCreating with a Multi-Attach event.
VolumeAttachment state identifies the original node as the current attachment.
The original terminating pod still has the filesystem mounted.
preconditions: The ledger-data PVC is bound, ReadWriteOnce, and contains evaluator-seeded data.
The original and replacement pod UIDs are known to the evaluator.
The storage control plane reports attachment state accurately.
required_evidence: Capture PVC access mode, bound PV identity, reclaim policy, and VolumeAttachment state.
Capture old and replacement pod UIDs, nodes, lifecycle state, and mount ownership.
Prove the original process has stopped and the filesystem is unmounted before detach.
Verify application data continuity and end-to-end probes after safe reattachment.

from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
import json, signal, sys
marker = Path("/data/ledger-seed.txt")
class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path.startswith("/seed"):
            marker.write_text("ledger-entry-0001\n", encoding="utf-8")
        ok = marker.exists() and marker.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "ledger-entry-0001\n"
        status = 200 if self.path.startswith("/healthz") or ok else 503
        body = json.dumps({"ok": status == 200, "ledger_continuity": ok}).encode()
        self.send_response(status); self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body)
    def log_message(self, *_args): return
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, lambda *_args: sys.exit(0))
ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler).serve_forever()

payload.rationale: The ReadWriteOnce volume ledger-data (PV pvc-38503d4b-1657-4f26-a069-09737f7f1f5f) is currently attached to node1 by the terminating pod ledger-primary. ledger-primary is prevented from completing graceful termination by the finalizer proofix.io/hold-termination and a 300s preStop sleep. Consequently, the replacement pod ledger-replacement scheduled on proofix-case13-worker is blocked in ContainerCreating with a FailedAttachVolume multi-attach conflict. Executing delete_pod on ledger-primary allows graceful shutdown, releases the finalizer, unmounts/detaches the RWO volume from node1, and enables ledger-replacement to attach the volume and become Ready.
payload.rollback_trigger: ledger-replacement enters CrashLoopBackOff or fails to attach the volume on proofix-case13-worker after ledger-primary termination.

success_criteria.description: ledger-primary is terminated and its VolumeAttachment on node1 is removed; ledger-replacement attaches PVC ledger-data on proofix-case13-worker, transitions to Running/Ready, and serves healthy traffic meeting SLO.
